def design(feats) -> Design:
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, dtype=float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, dtype=float)
    n, p = X.shape; ids = tuple(feats.ids); cap = max(0, int(MAX_DRIVERS))
    if n < 20 or not p or not cap or np.unique(y).size < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    sd = X.std(axis=0); valid = np.flatnonzero(sd > 1e-8)
    X = (X - X.mean(axis=0)) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-8)
    labels = tuple(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] +
        [np.array([s == t for s in feats.stratum], float) for t in labels[1:]])

    def fit(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(35):
            eta = Z @ b; mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -35, 35)))
            w = np.maximum(mu * (1 - mu), 1e-8)
            H = Z.T @ (w[:, None] * Z) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu))
            step /= max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(step)) / 3.0)
            old = np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta))
            for _ in range(12):
                eta1 = Z @ (b + step)
                if np.sum(y * eta1 - np.logaddexp(0, eta1)) >= old - 1e-9: break
                step *= 0.5
            b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        eta = Z @ b
        return float(np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)))

    def matrix(js):
        return np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, j] for j in js])

    R = np.abs(np.atleast_2d(np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False))))
    selected = []
    while len(selected) < min(cap, 3):
        Z = matrix(selected); l0 = fit(Z); alpha = (0.05 if not selected else 0.025) / p
        gains = {j: fit(np.column_stack([Z, X[:, j]])) - l0 for j in valid
                 if j not in selected and all(R[j, k] < 0.6 for k in selected)}
        if not gains: break
        best = max(gains, key=gains.get)
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2 * gains[best]), 1) >= alpha: break
        cluster = np.flatnonzero((R[R[best] >= 0.6] >= 0.6).any(axis=0))
        candidates = [j for j in cluster if j in gains and gains[j] >= gains[best] - 1]
        def residual(j):
            Zj = np.column_stack([Z, X[:, j]]); lj = l0 + gains[j]
            return sum(max(0, fit(np.column_stack([Zj, X[:, k]])) - lj)
                       for k in cluster if k != j and k not in selected)
        chosen = min(candidates, key=residual) if len(candidates) > 1 else best
        selected.append(chosen)
    for j in selected[:]:
        Z = matrix([k for k in selected if k != j])
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2 * (fit(np.column_stack([Z, X[:, j]])) - fit(Z))), 1)
        if pv >= 0.01: selected.remove(j)

    Z = matrix(selected); pairs = []; cutoff = 0.002 / max(1, p * (p + 1) // 2)
    for ai, a in enumerate(valid):
        for c in valid[ai:]:
            if a != c and R[a, c] >= 0.95: continue
            needed = [j for j in dict.fromkeys((a, c)) if j not in selected]
            Zm = np.column_stack([Z] + [X[:, j] for j in needed])
            v = X[:, a] * X[:, c]; vs = v.std()
            if vs < 1e-8: continue
            v = (v - v.mean()) / vs
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2 * (fit(np.column_stack([Zm, v])) - fit(Zm))), 1)
            if pv < cutoff: pairs.append((pv, int(a), int(c)))
    products = []; columns = list(selected); drivers = list(selected)
    for pv, a, c in sorted(pairs):
        additions = [j for j in dict.fromkeys((a, c)) if j not in drivers]
        if len(drivers) + len(additions) > cap: continue
        if any(j not in drivers and any(R[j, k] >= 0.6 for k in drivers) for j in (a, c)): continue
        products.append((ids[a], ids[c])); drivers.extend(additions)
        columns.extend(j for j in additions if j not in columns)
        break
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers),
                  columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in columns), products=tuple(products), loadings={})
